independence: NOT independent: this session wrote the rule fixes between rounds (curate.py body-variant rule, Infiniti engine rules, Nissan cab note and body codes, production "from" windows). method: CURATION_SPEC 11.4 as far as this task allows: 30 groups (stratified by category, cross-model first) + 30 donor pairs per round, seeded. Page re-read = the raw records and list manifests on oem-raw (the fetch cache holds only robots.txt and this task forbids new fetches, so no live page was read). Outside evidence = web search result text (dealer/aftermarket listings), the standard the hub accepted for the wiper round 2. Tools: scraper/oem_fitment/audit11_4/.
